scope: Lightweight RC3 source of truth for practitioner-facing surfaces (marketing site, Quick Start, Troubleshooting, Scope & Limitations page, Edge workspace chrome). Full design system belongs to MMP-1.1. Consumers copy values; the release content gate asserts the primary color and body font stay present in each surface so drift fails loudly.
change_policy: Token changes require a version bump (v0.2, ...) in release history and re-verification of every consumer surface. Independent per-file edits to these values are forbidden.
